title: A bill with a sieve
hook: Some ducks separate food from water.

knows: Birds have body structures and interact with their surroundings.
doesNotKnow: The comb-like bill edges are shown retaining particles while water exits. This is a simplified feeding step; ducks differ in diet and bill structure, and the drawing is not an anatomical cross-section.

misconception: The observed arrangement has a different effect than the one shown.
objective: A dabbling duck takes in water with small food particles. What do bill-edge structures help it do?
